items.name: Fix misfire (plugs and coil packs)
items.description: Diagnose code P0300, replace spark plugs and the failed coil pack.
items.reason: A truck that runs smoothly with no check-engine light draws far more bidders.

items.name: Replace front bumper cover
items.description: Aftermarket bumper cover, painted to match, installed.
items.reason: Visible front damage is the first thing buyers see in listing photos.

items.name: Interior dry-out and deodorize
items.description: Extract moisture, treat for mildew and run an ozone odor treatment.
items.reason: Musty odor is the biggest driver of low bids on flood vehicles.

items.name: Full flood remediation
items.description: Replace carpet, padding and seat rails, plus a full electrical inspection.
items.reason: The title stays flood-branded either way, so buyers won't pay this back.

scenarios.explanation: Low-cost fixes that make the truck run and look right pay off, even at a salvage sale. Skip the full flood remediation.
The repairs help, but dealers still discount the flood history heavily, so this stays the weaker option.
